controllerStatus.note: docker socket connection reset; the ~9.1GB vLLM image pull was in progress when the launcher stop-instances landed

rootCause: launcher controller-start payload backgrounded a compound AND-list (cd && env … nohup …) that retained the SSM command output pipe; the SSM invocation stayed InProgress, the launcher hit its 120s wait, declared failure and requested stop-instances, which interrupted the in-progress vLLM image pull. The image digest sha256:c2f3b1b9… is present in ECR (9110688401 bytes, pushed 2026-08-22); whether the pull would have completed within the window was NOT established, because the stop pre-empted it.
